SELECT COUNT(*) FROM study_user_role WHERE user_name = 'root' AND study_id IN ( SELECT study_id FROM study WHERE oc_oid IN ('S_RIS_DEMO', 'S_AMD_DEMO'));

changeSet.comment:
2026-06-22 user-feedback round 8: the OCT-portal demo studies (RIS, AMD) were seeded with subjects + event definitions but no study_user_role rows, so no operator account could reach them via the study picker. The public OCT upload portal does cross-study subject matching that bypasses the grant table, which is why EIAMD139 resolves into the RIS study during an upload — but the in-shell SPA path can't view that match because root has no role on the RIS row.
Grant root the Administrator role on both demo studies so they appear in the picker and the in-shell view of the uploader-matched subjects becomes possible. status_id=1 = AVAILABLE; role_name=admin maps to Role.ADMIN via the legacy lookup (see Role.java).
